name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper standard Mutual NDA Standard Terms, allowing two parties to exchange confidential information for an agreed purpose.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, used to fill in the parties, purpose, term, and governing law that incorporate the Mutual NDA Standard Terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) Standard Terms for vendors providing a cloud-hosted software service to customers.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for giving an early customer access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement (SLA) Standard Terms defining uptime targets, response times, and service credit remedies for a cloud service.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) Standard Terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA) governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and a processor/subprocessor.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement Standard Terms for licensing software, including deliverables, order forms, and governing terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement Standard Terms covering obligations, fees, trademark licensing, and confidentiality between business partners.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Standard Terms for HIPAA-regulated handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) between a covered entity and a business associate.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement Standard Terms for giving a prospective customer time-limited access to evaluate a product before entering into a definitive agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum Standard Terms supplementing an existing agreement with terms governing the use of AI services, inputs, outputs, and model training.
